definitions.class_justification: The condition is a general nonblocking configuration advisory.
definitions.summary: A valid configuration setting has one concrete better-supported alternative.
definitions.title: Configuration advisory has a supported correction

definitions.class_justification: The condition is a general configuration-authoring deprecation, not runtime lifecycle or recovery.
definitions.summary: A supported configuration field is scheduled for removal under a versioned rule.
definitions.title: Configuration setting is deprecated

definitions.class_justification: The identity remains compatible and the condition is a nonblocking qualification advisory.
definitions.summary: The software identity is supported, but differs from the preferred compatibility line.
definitions.title: Software identity is compatible with an advisory

definitions.class_justification: Undecodable source bytes are invalid configuration input.
definitions.summary: The configuration source cannot be decoded as UTF-8.
definitions.title: Configuration source is not UTF-8

definitions.class_justification: An empty document is incomplete configuration input.
definitions.summary: The configuration contains no YAML value after comments and whitespace are removed.
definitions.title: Configuration document is empty

definitions.class_justification: Malformed YAML is invalid input.
definitions.summary: The configuration cannot be parsed because its YAML syntax is malformed.
definitions.title: Malformed YAML syntax

definitions.class_justification: Additional YAML documents make the input unsupported and incomplete as one configuration.
definitions.summary: The configuration source contains more than one YAML document.
definitions.title: Multiple YAML documents

definitions.class_justification: A custom tag is input the bounded parser cannot safely decode.
definitions.summary: The configuration contains a YAML tag outside the supported safe core types.
definitions.title: Unsupported YAML tag

definitions.class_justification: Non-string keys are malformed for the configuration path model.
definitions.summary: A configuration mapping uses a key that is not a string.
definitions.title: Non-string mapping key

definitions.class_justification: Anchors are unsupported input because they obscure direct source ownership.
definitions.summary: The configuration contains a YAML anchor.
definitions.title: YAML anchor is unsupported

definitions.class_justification: Aliases are unsupported input because expanded values would lose direct provenance.
definitions.summary: The configuration contains a YAML alias.
definitions.title: YAML alias is unsupported

definitions.class_justification: Merge keys are unsupported input because merged ownership and duplicate handling are ambiguous.
definitions.summary: The configuration contains a YAML merge key.
definitions.title: YAML merge key is unsupported

definitions.class_justification: A non-mapping root is malformed configuration input.
definitions.summary: The YAML document root is not a configuration mapping.
definitions.title: Root value is not a mapping

definitions.class_justification: An unrepresentable scalar is undecodable input.
definitions.summary: A scalar cannot be constructed under the supported YAML 1.2 core semantics.
definitions.title: YAML scalar cannot be represented safely

definitions.class_justification: Duplicate keys are contradictory input with no safe winner.
definitions.summary: One mapping defines the same configuration key more than once.
definitions.title: Duplicate configuration key

definitions.class_justification: A malformed schema identifier is invalid input.
definitions.summary: The config_schema field is not a positive integer.
definitions.title: Invalid configuration schema identifier

definitions.class_justification: A missing required field is incomplete input.
definitions.summary: A field required by the selected configuration schema is absent.
definitions.title: Required configuration field is missing

definitions.class_justification: A value of the wrong structural type is invalid input.
definitions.summary: A configuration value does not have the strict type required by the schema.
definitions.title: Configuration value has the wrong type

definitions.class_justification: An unrecognized enum value is invalid input.
definitions.summary: A configuration value is not one of the schema's supported enum choices.
definitions.title: Configuration value is outside its allowed choices

definitions.class_justification: An undersized field is incomplete input.
definitions.summary: A string or sequence contains fewer items than the schema permits.
definitions.title: Configuration value is too short

definitions.class_justification: An oversized field is invalid input.
definitions.summary: A string or sequence contains more items than the schema permits.
definitions.title: Configuration value is too long

definitions.class_justification: A structurally incomplete or oversized tuple is invalid input.
definitions.summary: A fixed-shape configuration sequence has the wrong number of items.
definitions.title: Fixed-length sequence has the wrong size

definitions.class_justification: An unrecognized field is invalid input rather than an instruction to ignore.
definitions.summary: The selected schema does not define a supplied configuration field.
definitions.title: Unknown configuration field

definitions.class_justification: The supplied bounded admission field is invalid input.
definitions.summary: A bounded configuration, job, authentication, upload, insert, or payload field failed objective admission validation.
definitions.title: Admission input is invalid

definitions.class_justification: A well-formed schema identifier can still select an incompatible version.
definitions.summary: The requested configuration schema version is not supported by this application release.
definitions.title: Unsupported configuration schema version

definitions.class_justification: The typed values are structurally valid but mutually contradictory.
definitions.summary: Individually typed configuration fields form an impossible or unsafe combination.
definitions.title: Configuration semantic invariant is contradictory

definitions.class_justification: The supplied identity or capability is well formed but incompatible with current authority.
definitions.summary: A software, schema, protocol, deployment, or capability identity is unsupported or incompatible.
definitions.title: Configuration compatibility requirement is unsupported

definitions.class_justification: The immutable report cannot be trusted as compatible admission evidence.
definitions.summary: A validator report is stale, malformed, contradictory, mismatched, or uses unsupported identities.
definitions.title: Validator report was rejected

definitions.class_justification: The primary operator-facing failure is access to an external filesystem source.
definitions.summary: The selected configuration file cannot be opened and read.
definitions.title: Configuration source cannot be read

definitions.class_justification: The primary condition is failure to access an external dependency during preflight.
definitions.summary: A required explicitly configured dependency is unavailable and no safe fallback is viable.
definitions.title: Required preflight dependency is unavailable

definitions.class_justification: The candidate remains usable through explicit degradation or fallback.
definitions.summary: An optional dependency or a dependency with a safe fallback is degraded or unavailable.
definitions.title: Preflight dependency is degraded or optional

definitions.class_justification: The capability remains usable through an explicitly degraded operational state.
definitions.summary: An accepting compatible capability remains usable but reports degraded operational health.
definitions.title: Compatible capability is degraded

definitions.class_justification: The input exhausts a declared size resource limit.
definitions.summary: The configuration file is larger than the compiler's bounded source limit.
definitions.title: Configuration source exceeds the byte limit

definitions.class_justification: The input exhausts a declared nesting resource limit.
definitions.summary: The YAML structure exceeds the compiler's maximum nesting depth.
definitions.title: Configuration nesting is too deep

definitions.class_justification: The input exhausts a declared structural resource limit.
definitions.summary: The YAML document exceeds the compiler's node-count limit.
definitions.title: Configuration contains too many YAML nodes

definitions.class_justification: The input exhausts a declared collection-capacity limit.
definitions.summary: One mapping or sequence exceeds the compiler's collection-item limit.
definitions.title: Configuration collection contains too many items

definitions.class_justification: The input exhausts a declared scalar-size limit.
definitions.summary: One YAML scalar exceeds the compiler's Unicode-code-point limit.
definitions.title: Configuration scalar exceeds the size limit

definitions.class_justification: The report reached a declared diagnostic-capacity limit.
definitions.summary: The compiler reached its bounded issue-count limit and omitted additional findings.
definitions.title: Additional configuration issues were omitted

definitions.class_justification: The probe exhausted its explicit time budget.
definitions.summary: A bounded read-only preflight probe did not complete before its declared deadline.
definitions.title: Environmental preflight probe timed out

definitions.class_justification: The controller remains available with an explicitly degraded optional service.
definitions.summary: An optional supervised task failed and the controller continued in a degraded state.
definitions.title: Optional supervised task degraded the controller

definitions.class_justification: The failure is fatal to the current controller process.
definitions.summary: An uncaught controller failure or failed required supervised task reached the process boundary.
definitions.title: Controller terminated after an uncaught fatal failure

definitions.class_justification: The condition is detected during next-start lifecycle reconciliation.
definitions.summary: A preserved marker shows that the previous controller instance did not complete clean shutdown.
definitions.title: Previous controller shutdown was incomplete

definitions.class_justification: The worker supplied invalid diagnostic input that could not be accepted safely.
definitions.summary: A worker diagnostic message was malformed, contradictory, unauthorized, or unsafe.
definitions.title: Worker diagnostic envelope was rejected

definitions.class_justification: The diagnostic contract is well formed but incompatible with controller authority.
definitions.summary: Worker and controller diagnostic schema or catalog identities are incompatible.
definitions.title: Worker diagnostic contract is incompatible
